name: r02-ext-v1
note: Extra actor ramps for the three R02 (Cain) enemies, light to dark, added on top of the unchanged art 03 master palette (byte copy in src/palette_v03.json). Ramp names must not collide with the base. Chosen to separate from grass (terrain.grass), the dirt path (terrain.path), A1 purple snake, A2 pink moth, A3 plum beast and the teal XP gems (gem/gem2), and to keep a dark value step before outline.0.

why.envy: B1 iris only (small area inside the pale sclera), acid yellow-green = envy; never a large area on grass
why.rage: B2 hound body: ember to oxblood, complementary to the grass and darker than the dirt path; orange rim light on the lit side
why.mask: B3 porcelain mask: warm ivory to stone, the brightest large shape of the three
why.shroud: B3 heavy shroud under the mask: dark slate blue, separate from A3 plum (beast) and from the player cloak's lighter blue
